description: Check a token before trading. level=quick: one-line pre-trade verdict for up to 10 tokens ($0.02). level=safety (default): contract / mint safety: honeypot simulation, buy/sell tax, mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 traps, holders, liquidity ($0.015). level=report: memecoin report with rug-risk %, launch structure, snipers, bundles and a plain summary ($0.05). level=max: all of it plus the holder trace of pump.fun / Base tokens, one verdict and every red flag ($0.15). For wallets use address_check; to find tokens use memecoin_screen. Live data (chain, RugCheck, DexScreener); 1-30 s. Signals, not advice. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

address.description: Token contract (0x...) or Solana mint. level=quick accepts up to 10, comma separated.

chain.description: Chain of a 0x token (Solana mints are detected). Default ethereum.
